findings: R2 editing_round1 provenance is classified as a prior-round edit only after retained candidate ID, full UTF-8 text digest and origin match R1 history; it is never counted as a new R2 proposal. Current proposals require exact registered ID and round-specific origin.

Original parent, prior edit and current edit categories partition selected cells. Exact full text equality, including whitespace and unscored suffixes, is separate from candidate provenance/ID equality. Missing parent text comparisons remain explicit.

V5 field names/shape match the supplement: eight editor_fit_authority_audits with dispatch_task, successful completed_task_receipt, canonical_spec_sha256 and sites; row parent_comparisons contain the copied common-valid masks/counts. Approved extractor/helper hashes and native/numeric bindings are enforced.

The supplement trusts the supplied terminal V5 aggregate as the already validated scoring/task authority, verifies signed immutable task projection and rereads only aggregate-pinned sources; no mutable GPU queue/service authority is substituted. Canonical event linkage remains distinct from raw source pins.

Producer spec.candidate_ids contains only valid scored candidates, so the scored/rejected disjoint-set check agrees with actual producer semantics. Round2 scored candidates must retain R1 IDs/text/origins.

Fit change counts are copied by source row/comparison index without fit computation, resampling, means/CIs or new endpoints. Missing fit-change fields stay missing; >1e-5 classification remains the reviewed V5 authority.

Journals stream one record at a time; only per-family cohorts/proposal ID sets and lightweight prior/next text hashes/origins are retained. No tensors/models are loaded. The proposed one-task 4GiB allocation is reasonable; actual terminal peak RSS remains unmeasured.

actual_round1_anchor_schema_check.scope: Embedded exact events and selections bound by preliminary dossier SHA, plus actual pinned spec files; no full journal rescan.

limits: Prospective source review only: final native/numeric artifacts and all eight real terminal editor journals have not been attested by this review.
Four anchors are illustrative and not editing acceptance prevalence; synthetic R2 fixtures do not establish actual final R2 coverage.
CLI end-to-end terminal mutation/authority guards were inspected, not exercised against a completed final artifact.
Selection origin and unchanged text do not establish truth, causal effect, quality gains or general editing efficacy.
